metrics.workdir_dsl:
workspace "Claims Center" "The insurance company's claims platform for reporting, triaging, assessing, and settling claims." {

    model {

        policyholder = person "Policyholder" "Reports claims and tracks their progress on the Claims Center platform."
        adjuster = person "Adjuster" "Processes assigned claims in the adjuster workbench."

        claimsCenter = softwareSystem "Claims Center" "The insurance company's platform for reporting, triaging, assessing, and settling claims." {

            webPortal = container "Web Portal" "Where policyholders report claims and track their progress." "Web application"
            mobileAppBackend = container "Mobile App Backend" "Serves the insurer's mobile app." "REST API"
            intake = container "Claims Intake Service" "Registers new claims." "Service"
            triage = container "Triage Service" "Classifies and prioritizes claims." "Service"
            assessment = container "Assessment Service" "Calculates settlement amounts." "Service"
            payout = container "Payout Service" "Executes claim settlements." "Service"
            fraudScreening = container "Fraud Screening Service" "Flags suspicious claims." "Service"
            documentService = container "Document Service" "Accepts claim photos and reports." "Service"
            notification = container "Notification Service" "Emails and messages policyholders." "Service"
            assignment = container "Assignment Service" "Routes claims to adjusters." "Service"
            adjusterWorkbench = container "Adjuster Workbench" "Where staff process their assigned claims." "Web application"
            policyVerification = container "Policy Verification Service" "Checks that a claim is covered by the policy." "Service"
            reinsuranceAllocation = container "Reinsurance Allocation Service" "Apportions large losses across reinsurance partners." "Service"
            batchScheduler = container "Batch Scheduler" "Runs the nightly reserves calculation." "Batch job"
            eventQueue = container "Event Queue" "Carries claim events between the application parts." "Message queue"
            claimsDb = container "Claims Database" "Stores claim records." "Database"
            policyDb = container "Policy Database" "Stores policy and cover records." "Database"
            auditDb = container "Audit Database" "Stores the compliance audit trail." "Database"
            documentStore = container "Document Store" "Holds claim photos, reports, and correspondence." "File storage"
        }

        claimsDataBureau = softwareSystem "National Claims Data Bureau" "A national claims data bureau operated by a different organization, consulted for fraud screening." "External"
        clearingHouse = softwareSystem "Clearing House" "A clearing house operated by a different organization, through which claim settlements are executed." "External"

        policyholder -> webPortal "reports claims and tracks claim progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        policyholder -> mobileAppBackend "reports claims and tracks claim progress via the insurer's mobile app" "HTTPS/JSON"
        adjuster -> adjusterWorkbench "processes assigned claims" "HTTPS/JSON"

        fraudScreening -> claimsDataBureau "consults for fraud screening" "HTTPS/JSON"
        payout -> clearingHouse "executes claim settlements through" "HTTPS/JSON"

        webPortal -> intake "submits new claims" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> assessment "tracks settlement progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> payout "tracks payout progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> documentService "uploads claim photos and reports" "HTTPS/JSON"
        webPortal -> notification "requests status notifications" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> intake "submits new claims" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> assessment "tracks settlement progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> payout "tracks payout progress" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> documentService "uploads claim photos and reports" "HTTPS/JSON"
        mobileAppBackend -> notification "requests status notifications" "HTTPS/JSON"

        intake -> triage "hands accepted claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        triage -> assessment "routes claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"
        assessment -> payout "requests settlements from" "HTTPS/JSON"
        assignment -> adjusterWorkbench "routes claims to" "HTTPS/JSON"

        documentService -> documentStore "reads claim documents from" "File API"
        batchScheduler -> claimsDb "reads and writes claim records" "SQL"
        batchScheduler -> policyDb "reads and writes policy records" "SQL"

        notification -> policyholder "reports claim status changes by email and message" "Email/SMS"
    }

    views {
        systemContext claimsCenter "SystemContext" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "System Context for Claims Center"
        }

        container claimsCenter "Containers" {
            include *
            autoLayout
            title "Containers for Claims Center"
        }
    }

    configuration {
        scope softwaresystem
    }
}
